### Findings (0)

---

**Decision:** `accept` — recorded by autonomous-review.
**Lenses:** `correctness` + `security` — 2 juror(s), one per lens, each a separate `judge` step spawned with its own derived session id (#3028) and its own tools (#3319). They ran SEQUENTIALLY and neither saw the other's findings; this is not a `judgePanel` fan-out (#3050). The other 3 panel lens(es) (simplicity, standards-conformance, claim-accuracy) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
**Earned vs seated:** this PR's code touch-set scores care `elevated` (blast-radius (agent-memory-src/index-verif.md, agent-memory-src/verify-before-asserting-the-tree.md, scripts/__tests__/backlog-lane-locus.test.mjs, …)), for which the care dial asks for 5 lens(es) × 1 juror(s)/lens × 2 round(s). This run seated 2 lens(es) (correctness, security), 1 juror each, in 1 round. SHORTFALL: 3 earned lens(es) (simplicity, standards-conformance, claim-accuracy) did not sit. The caller declared no `--careLevel`, so nothing checked the shape this run was dialled for against the files it actually judged (#3335). The shortfall is structural — the step list is fixed at registration (#3319) — so it is RECORDED here rather than implied away: do not read the seats above as the whole review this PR earned.
Net basis: `885352b52657296d676d8628187632a870587aa8..0c69526f6f3dcbc073dbb612edb79b006bad9a03` (rev `origin/lane/xzitlr9-dispatcher-operations` at review time) — 21 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.

_Recorded through the declared `review-pr` operation (#3035)._
